title: Constraint: Binary Matrix Row/Column Sums
constraints: A 4 × 4 matrix of bits with exactly **two ones in every row and every column** (90 such matrices exist).
Runs on Verilator with the z3 solver (`sudo pacman -S z3`).
hints: Sums of 1-bit values need a cast (`int'(m[i][0]) + …`), or the sum is evaluated in 1 bit.
Verilator ignores `m[i].sum() with (…)` on a row of a 2-D array (you'll see a warning), so write the four terms out.
Column sums: iterate `foreach (m[0][j])` and add `m[0][j] … m[3][j]`.

examples.check: every row has exactly two ones
